_comment: L3 label data only — never derived from chain. originId/certId hex values here are just deterministic UTF-8-padded Bytes<32> (same encoding as contract/e2e/run.ts's bytes32() helper), not secrets. POST /admin/origins with a new label appends a runtime entry to agent/.state/registry-runtime.json (gitignored), merged over this seed at read time — this file itself is never mutated by the running agent.
_parties_comment: Public directory of each party's on-chain partyId (a one-way hash of its secret, never the secret itself). Only needed once agents run separated (AGENT_PARTIES, one party per process, see HANDOFF.md §4 / README.md 'Running as a single-company agent') — a demo/Preprod agent that hosts every party computes partyId locally instead and ignores this. Fill in a party's entry by running `npx tsx src/cli/print-identity.ts` on the agent that actually holds that party's secret and pasting its output here; every other agent that certifies suppliers then reads it from here. Filled in 2026-09-13 from the real Preprod .state/preprod secrets once the Compact toolchain became available (HANDOFF.md §0) and verified end to end across three separate processes.
